query: I want to be emailed about what happens in my repos, and I want my error alert emails to get investigated and fixed automatically. My repos are github.com/example/webapp and github.com/example/api. I'm in Berlin.
expected_behavior: Lists existing deployed routines before proposing anything, and enters bootstrap mode only after finding no managed watchdog
Interviews for notification channel, unattended-change tolerance, and ops repo choice before designing
Proposes a fleet table (archetype, cadence, artifact contract) and gets agreement before writing prompts
Writes fleet/fleet.json plus one prompt file per routine from templates/, runs scripts/validate_fleet.py, and commits+pushes the ops repo BEFORE deploying
Converts Berlin local times to UTC crons, confirms the conversion explicitly, and staggers schedules so the watchdog fires after all other windows close

Deploys routines one at a time, writes returned trigger_ids back into the manifest, deploys the watchdog last with the ops repo as first git source, and ends with a hand-off table including usage estimates
